recognize_zh: 這是一張分類表而非形態圖：列出 WHO 2016 EBV 陽性 T/NK 細胞增生性疾病與好發年齡；前五項（EBV-HLH、全身性 CAEBV、水痘樣皰疹樣 LPD、嚴重蚊蟲叮咬過敏、全身性 EBV+ T 細胞淋巴瘤）好發於兒童青少年，後三項好發於成人。
features: Table with two columns: diagnosis and usual patient age group
Pediatric/adolescent entities: EBV-positive HLH, systemic CAEBV, cutaneous CAEBV (hydroa vacciniforme-like LPD and severe mosquito bite allergy), systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood
Adult entities: aggressive NK-cell leukemia, extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma nasal type, nodal peripheral T-cell lymphoma EBV-positive
Footnote: nodal EBV-positive PTCL is included within PTCL, NOS in WHO 2016
describe_en: This figure is a classification table rather than a morphologic image. It lists the WHO 2016 EBV-positive T-cell and NK-cell proliferations with their usual age groups: EBV-positive hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, systemic chronic active EBV infection, the cutaneous CAEBV forms (hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder and severe mosquito bite allergy) and systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma occur mainly in children and adolescents, whereas aggressive NK-cell leukemia, extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma nasal type, and nodal EBV-positive PTCL occur mainly in adults. It frames hydroa vacciniforme-like LPD as a cutaneous CAEBV spectrum disorder of the pediatric group.
